description: This file implements classes and functions related to managing broken alternative network services, including delay calculations, state management, and expiration scheduling within the Chromium networking codebase.

classes.name: BrokenAlternativeService
classes.description: Represents a network service that is marked as broken, including comparison operators for ordering.

classes.name: BrokenAlternativeServices
classes.description: Manages a collection of broken network services, including marking, expiration, and state management.

methods.name: ComputeBrokenAlternativeServiceExpirationDelay
methods.description: Calculates delay before a broken service is considered expired, based on failure count and backoff settings.

methods.name: BrokenAlternativeService::BrokenAlternativeService
methods.description: Constructor initializing a broken alternative service with given parameters.

methods.name: BrokenAlternativeService::~BrokenAlternativeService
methods.description: Destructor.

methods.name: BrokenAlternativeService::operator<
methods.description: Comparison operator for ordering broken services.

methods.name: BrokenAlternativeServices::BrokenAlternativeServices
methods.description: Constructor initializing the collection with parameters.

methods.name: BrokenAlternativeServices::~BrokenAlternativeServices
methods.description: Destructor.

methods.name: BrokenAlternativeServices::Clear
methods.description: Clears all stored broken service data and cancels expiration timers.

methods.name: BrokenAlternativeServices::MarkBrokenUntilDefaultNetworkChanges
methods.description: Marks a service as broken until a default network change occurs.

methods.name: BrokenAlternativeServices::MarkBroken
methods.description: Marks a service as broken based on timer expiration.

methods.name: BrokenAlternativeServices::MarkBrokenImpl
methods.description: Internal method to add a broken service to tracking structures and schedule expiration.

methods.name: BrokenAlternativeServices::MarkRecentlyBroken
methods.description: Records a service as recently broken.

methods.name: BrokenAlternativeServices::IsBroken
methods.description: Checks if a service is currently marked as broken.

methods.name: BrokenAlternativeServices::IsBroken
methods.description: Checks if a service is broken and retrieves its expiration time.

methods.name: BrokenAlternativeServices::WasRecentlyBroken
methods.description: Checks if a service was recently marked as broken.

methods.name: BrokenAlternativeServices::Confirm
methods.description: Removes a service from broken tracking, typically on network change.

methods.name: BrokenAlternativeServices::OnDefaultNetworkChanged
methods.description: Handles network change event, confirming all services marked on default network.

methods.name: BrokenAlternativeServices::SetBrokenAndRecentlyBrokenAlternativeServices
methods.description: Bulk updates the list of broken services and recently broken services.

methods.name: BrokenAlternativeServices::SetDelayParams
methods.description: Adjusts delay calculation parameters.

methods.name: BrokenAlternativeServices::broken_alternative_service_list
methods.description: Returns the list of broken services with expiration times.

methods.name: BrokenAlternativeServices::recently_broken_alternative_services
methods.description: Returns the cache of recently broken services.

methods.name: BrokenAlternativeServices::AddToBrokenListAndMap
methods.description: Adds a service to the sorted list and map for expiration management.

methods.name: BrokenAlternativeServices::ExpireBrokenAlternateProtocolMappings
methods.description: Expires services whose delay has elapsed and notifies delegate.

methods.name: BrokenAlternativeServices::ScheduleBrokenAlternateProtocolMappingsExpiration
methods.description: Schedules timer for next service expiration.
